_about: Yearly management fees (percent) published for French life insurance (assurance-vie) and PER contracts, researched in October 2026 from the brokers' and insurers' own documents. uc_fee applies to units of account (funds, ETFs), euro_fee to the euro fund; null when only a cap is published. Robo-advisors' uc_fee includes their management fee. Suggestions only: users can set their own rate.

contracts.name: Linxea Spirit 2
contracts.notes: UC: 0,125%/quarter = 0,50%/yr. Fonds Euro Nouvelle Generation: '2% maximum par an' (a cap, the actual fee is not published; Linxea's page also shows '2 % maximum'), so euro_fee left null. Croissance Allocation Long Terme: 1% max/yr in the NAV + up to 10% performance fee. Gestion pilotee: +0,20% to +0,70%/yr on UC depending on profile (OTEA +0,20%, Yomoni +0,70%). Shares (titres vifs): 0,60% buy/sell spread; ETFs: 0,10% spread.

contracts.name: Linxea Avenir 2
contracts.notes: euro_fee is for fonds Suravenir Rendement 2 (0,60%). Fonds Suravenir Opportunites 2: '3,00% maximum'. Mandat d'arbitrage (gestion pilotee, e.g. Amundi ETF): +0,39%/yr on UC (Linxea states 0,99% max total on UC); OTEA: +0,20%. The fee table is titled 'LINXEA AVENIR 2+' (contrat n°2284) and is the one linked from the Avenir 2 page. The first Linxea Avenir (closed to new subscribers, also Suravenir) has no fee table online: Avenir 2's fees are used as an estimate for it.

contracts.name: Linxea Vie
contracts.notes: Notice: UC (incl. ETF) 0,15%/quarter max = 0,60%/yr; shares held directly (Actions/titres vifs) 0,70%/yr max. Fonds euros Netissima, Eurossima, Vertessima: 0,75% max each. Fonds croissance: 0,75% max. Gestion pilotee: mandate fee on top (Amundi ETF +0,39%/yr; OTEA +0,20%; Carmignac +0,20% per Linxea's page). The fee table (tableau de frais, Dec 2025) shows 'Support unites de compte 0,70% maximum', which is the titres-vifs rate.

contracts.name: Linxea Zen
contracts.notes: euro_fee is for APICIL Euro Garanti (0,60% max). APICIL EuroFlex: 1,6% max per the CG and Linxea's page, but the fee table says '2 % maximum'. Gestion pilotee / pilotee profilee (OTEA): +0,20% max on UC.

contracts.name: Linxea Spirit PER
contracts.notes: UC: 0,125%/quarter max = 0,50%/yr max. Fonds Euro PER Nouvelle Generation: '2 % maximum par an' (cap only, euro_fee null). Gestion pilotee a horizon: no extra fee. Gestion pilotee: +0,20% to +0,70%/yr (OTEA 0,20%, Yomoni 0,70%). Croissance Allocation Long Terme: 1% max. Association fee: 10 EUR at subscription.

contracts.name: Linxea Suravenir PER
contracts.source: https://www.linxea.com/document/suravenir-per-tableau-de-frais/ (Transparence de frais SURAVENIR PER, mis a jour le 01/01/2026); https://www.linxea.com/per/suravenir-per/
contracts.notes: There is no product called 'Linxea Avenir PER': Linxea's Suravenir PER is marketed as 'Suravenir PER' / 'Linxea Suravenir PER' (contrat n°2240). Gestion horizon retraite: no extra fee. Mandat d'arbitrage: +0,30%. The same 'Suravenir PER' is also sold by Lucya.

contracts.name: Linxea Apicil PER
contracts.notes: There is no product called 'Linxea Zen PER': Linxea's Apicil PER is 'Linxea Apicil PER', underlying contract INTENCIAL Liberalys Retraite. The figures (UC 0,6%, Apicil Euro Garanti 0,85%) come from Linxea's product page (undated). The contract's generic CG and Intencial fee table (2025-05) only give caps: 1% max on Apicil Euro Garanti and on UC in gestion libre/horizon, with higher caps for gestion deleguee (1,90%), libre smart (1,80%), pilotee (1,80%). Gestion horizon retraite: no extra fee.

contracts.name: Lucya Cardif
contracts.notes: euro_fee is for the Fonds general (0,70% max). Fonds Euro Private Strategies: not stated on the fee table (the product page footnote mentions a '3% max' management fee basis). Gestion deleguee (conseillee par Lucya): +0,25%/yr on UC. ETF and titres vifs: 0,10% max transaction fee. Association fee 10 EUR. Lucya also sells Lucya CNP, Lucya Abeille, Lucya by AXA.

contracts.name: Lucya Cardif PER
contracts.notes: euro_fee is for the Fonds general Retraite. Gestion pilotee par horizon: 0,50% maximum per the fee table. Gestion deleguee Lucya: +0,25% (0,75% total on UC per the FAQ). Association fee 20 EUR.

contracts.name: Placement-direct Vie
contracts.notes: Shares held directly (titres vifs): 0,80%/yr. Allocation deleguee: +0,40%/yr, or +0,70% for the 'Opportunites 100% Trackers' allocation. Placement-direct also sells Placement-direct Euro+ (SwissLife), Essentiel (Generali) and Patrimoine (Garance), not covered here.

contracts.name: PER Placement-direct
contracts.notes: Insurer is SwissLife (not Suravenir). Same 0,60% in gestion libre and in gestion pilotee par horizon. Association (AGIS) fee 25 EUR. Placement-direct also sells 'Placement-direct Retraite ISR' (UMR), not covered.

contracts.name: BoursoVie
contracts.notes: UC, ETF and shares: 0,1875%/quarter max = 0,75%/yr max. Fonds euros Euro Exclusif and Eurossima: 0,75% max. Gestion pilotee: no mandate fee. Legacy 'Ex Direct' (ex ING Direct Vie) contracts have their own CG (https://s.brsimg.com/content/pdf/avie/cg-ing-direct-vie-decembre-2021.pdf), not checked.

contracts.name: PERin MATLA
contracts.notes: Product page FAQ: 'Frais de gestion du contrat sur les unites de comptes et sur le fonds en Euros : 0,50%'. Pilotage horizon retraite adds an allocation fee: the FAQ says 0,37%/yr max, the fee breakdown on the same page says 0,35%. The page is undated; the notice was not reachable without signing in.

contracts.name: Fortuneo Vie
contracts.notes: Gestion libre: UC 0,75%; Suravenir Rendement 2 0,60%; Suravenir Opportunites 2 '3,00% maximum'. Gestion sous mandat: UC 0,85%, fonds euros (Suravenir Rendement) 0,60%. Current product page shows the same figures.

contracts.name: Fortuneo PER
contracts.notes: Gestion libre: UC 0,50%, fonds euros 0,70%. Gestion a horizon: UC 0,70%, fonds euros 0,70%. +0,14% on all fees if the optional accidental-death guarantee is chosen.

contracts.name: Bourse Direct Horizon
contracts.source: https://www.generali.fr/sites/default/files-d8/2026-08/Bourse-Direct-Horizon.pdf (Generali fee table, file dated 2026-08-05, fund averages au 31/12/2025)
contracts.notes: Insurer's fee table: fonds euros 0,75% max (Netissima), UC 0,65% max, Eurocroissance 0,75% max, gestion pilotee +0,20% max. boursedirect.fr could not be reached (connection reset). Secondary sources say UC fees went from 0,75% to 0,65% on 1 July 2024; Bourse Direct's 2020 press release still shows 0,75%.

contracts.name: e-PER Generali (Bourse Direct)
contracts.notes: Bourse Direct's PER (launched Nov 2025) is the e-PER Generali, not a 'Bourse Direct Horizon PER'. UC 0,65% comes from Bourse Direct's own press release. Euro fund fee is not stated by Bourse Direct; Generali's generic E-PER fee table gives caps only (fonds euros 1,00% max, UC 1,60% max, versement 1% max), so euro_fee is null. A comparison site (finance-heros.fr) says 0,80% on the euro fund (secondary, unverified). boursedirect.fr was unreachable.

contracts.name: Lucya Abeille
contracts.notes: Abeille's online-sold life insurance via Lucya. Euro fund: Fonds Abeille Actif Garanti. Gestion sous mandat: +0,20% max. Association fee 15 EUR (paid by Abeille). abeille-assurances.fr and afer.fr return 403 to automated clients, so Abeille's own direct contracts and Afer contracts could not be checked.

contracts.name: Lucya Abeille PER
contracts.notes: Euro fund: Abeille RP Garantie Retraite. Gestion evolutive: 0% extra. Gestion sous mandat: +0,20% max. Association fee 20 EUR (paid by Abeille). Abeille's own PER products were not checkable (403).

contracts.name: Lucya CNP
contracts.notes: Extra contract (not requested), included because it has the lowest UC fee found. Euro fund: CNP Lucya Euros B. Shares: 0,3%. Gestion pilotee: +0,25% max.

contracts.name: Lucya CNP PER
contracts.notes: Extra contract (not requested). Euro fund: CNP Lucya PER Euros B. Gestion pilotee (deleguee): +0,25%; gestion Horizon: 0% extra (per the product page).

contracts.name: Yomoni Vie
contracts.source: https://www.suravenir.fr/wp-content/uploads/pdf/9C340_Yomoni-Vie_YOMONI-1.pdf (Transparence de frais YOMONI VIE, mis a jour le 31/03/2023); https://www.yomoni.fr/tarifs
contracts.notes: Mandate-only product, so uc_fee is the total wrapper fee: contract 0,60% + Yomoni mandate 0,70%. Yomoni's pricing page shows 0,6% insurer + 0,7% Yomoni + ~0,3% ETF fees = '1,6% max tout compris' (the ETF part is a fund cost, not included in uc_fee). Fonds euros 0,60% max per the insurer table (Yomoni's page does not state a euro fee).

contracts.name: Nalo Patrimoine
contracts.notes: Mandate-only product, so uc_fee is the total wrapper fee: Nalo mandate 0,90% + insurer 0,50%. Euro fund 0,85% = Nalo 0,35% + insurer 0,50%. ETF costs ~0,25% on top. Nalo states a max of 1,65%/yr. Insurer identified from the Generali Vie footer of the fee table (the pricing page doesn't name it).

contracts.name: PER Nalo
contracts.notes: Mandate-only: UC 1,35% = Nalo 0,90% + insurer 0,45%. Euro fund (APICIL Euro Garanti) 0,85% = Nalo 0,15% + insurer 0,70%. Horizon and deleguee: +0%. ETF costs ~0,25% on top. Fee table undated.

contracts.name: Mes Placements Liberté
contracts.notes: Closed to new subscriptions (page updated 22 Jan 2026), still managed. euro_fee is for the Fonds Euro General (0,70%). Gestion pilotee: +0,20% to +0,30%/yr depending on the manager. Successor 'Mes Placements Liberte 2' became 'Meilleurtaux Liberte Vie' (separate entry). mesplacements.fr itself was unreachable (connection reset).

contracts.name: Meilleurtaux Liberté Vie
contracts.notes: Fonds Euro Nouvelle Generation: '2 % maximum / an' (cap only, euro_fee null). Fonds Euro Objectif Climat: no fee stated. Croissance Allocation Long Terme: 1% max + up to 10% performance fee. Gestion pilotee: +0,40%/yr (Prudent, Equilibre, Dynamique), +0,50% (Audacieux); the 2020 CG said +0,20% to +0,30%.

contracts.name: Meilleurtaux Liberté PER
contracts.notes: No product named 'Mes Placements Retraite' was found; Mes-placements' PER was 'Mes Placements Liberte PER', now 'Meilleurtaux Liberte PER' (rename visible in the 2020 Meilleurtaux article URL). Fonds Euro PER Nouvelle Generation: '2 % maximum / an' (cap only, euro_fee null). Gestion pilotee: +0,40% (Prudent/Equilibre/Dynamique), +0,50% (Audacieux). Croissance Allocation Long Terme: 1% max. Product page undated.
